_comment: Connector-specific edits to GENERATED files that a cli-printing-press reprint must NOT clobber. check_handfixes.py asserts every marker below is still present (and banned anti-patterns absent) and fails CI if a reprint dropped one. status: active = connector-only, a reprint would clobber it; upstreamed = also fixed in the press, a reprint from a fixed press regenerates it, but the back-port must still be present today.

handfixes.summary: Better Stack updates are PATCH; monitors/heartbeats update + MCP update path call PatchWithParams, not PutWithParams
handfixes.why: Better Stack's Update endpoints are HTTP PATCH (partial update); a PUT 405s. Prior prints hand-fixed PUT->PATCH post-generate. The durable home is the spec (`method: PATCH`, which 4.22 emits natively as PatchWithParams), but the back-port must be present in the generated client + update commands today or every update fails.
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: Encode `method: PATCH` on the update operations in the press spec so PatchWithParams is emitted by construction (4.22+ supports this).

handfixes.summary: Live fan-out parsers decode IDs with json.Number + dec.UseNumber() so 7+ digit monitor IDs don't render in scientific notation
handfixes.why: Better Stack monitor/resource IDs are 7+ digits. An `any`->float64->%v decode renders them as 1.234e+06, silently breaking mirror joins (false 'monitor missing' + suppressed real drift). Only round-2 adversarial review caught it; the unit test masked it with a 5-digit ID. json.Number preserves the exact integer. Lives in the hand-authored statuspage-audit novel and the store decode path.

handfixes.summary: gen_governance keyword classifier mis-tiered incident verbs; hand-corrected: acknowledge/resolve/import -> Write, triage/workflow-archive -> Read
handfixes.why: gen_governance.py keyword-matches command paths and ignores pp:method, so for this incident/monitoring connector it BOTH false-negatived real writes (`incidents acknowledge`, `incidents resolve`, verb-less `import`) into Read AND false-positived read-only `triage` (a local incident board view) and `workflow archive` (local-only sync) into Write. The tiers were hand-corrected against the real method surface (12 routine writes). A full reprint re-runs gen_governance and would re-introduce the mis-tiering. See project_betterstack_onboard_gotchas, project_gen_governance_misses_verbless_writes.
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: Make gen_governance method-aware off agent-context pp:method (fleet-wide fix); until then this hand-correction recurs on every reprint.

handfixes.summary: doctor probes a real GET endpoint with the real credential and refuses to dial a placeholder base_url, instead of calling any HTTP response 'reachable' and never checking the credential
handfixes.why: `doctor` is the command every SKILL, guide and docs page tells an operator to run to confirm the connector works, and it could not tell a working install from a broken one. It called any HTTP response to `GET /` "reachable" and rendered it green, so a base_url aimed at the vendor's web UI (where every API path 404s) and a token rejected with 401 on every call both produced an all-green report. On this connector family it also never probed the credential at all: it printed "present, not verified" and left the operator to guess. The mirror defect: a connector whose shipped base_url default is a placeholder dialled the placeholder host, and the DNS failure rendered as "FAIL API: unreachable" - telling a correctly-credentialled operator they were broken without naming the one variable that would fix it. Several placeholder hosts resolve through live wildcard DNS and answer real HTTP, so dialling one produced a confident green verdict against a stranger's server. Measured and gated by tools/maintainer/check_doctor_truth.py. See issue #282.

handfixes.summary: every operator credential this connector reads is declared on all three install channels: manifest.json (.mcpb), server.json (MCP Registry) and mcp-install.md (manual install)
handfixes.why: Issue #282 ('three live-verified connectors prompt for the wrong credentials'). A connector is installed through THREE independent channels that each carry their own copy of the credential list: manifest.json server.mcp_config.env (what the .mcpb bundle hands Claude Desktop, which has no shell profile, no config.toml and no export - so an undeclared variable is a variable nobody is ever asked for), server.json environmentVariables (the MCP Registry publish channel), and mcp-install.md's copy-paste JSON blocks plus its remote launch line (the manual path, which never touches the bundle at all). The fleet-wide audit found 60 of 65 connectors under-declaring 122 operator-facing variables in the manifest, 61 of 65 mcp-install.md pages omitting 125, and hudu's server.json missing the base URL its manifest marks required. For betterstack the manifest gained: BETTERSTACK_BASE_URL. server.json gained: BETTERSTACK_BASE_URL. mcp-install.md's env blocks gained: BETTERSTACK_BASE_URL. manifest.json, server.json and mcp-install.md are ALL regenerated by /msp-skills-publish on an UPDATE or re-onboard, so without this ledger a regeneration silently drops every declaration and CI stays green (check_env_schema.py is wired --warn). The asserts below name the specific credentials, not a count, so dropping one and adding another cannot cancel out.
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: cli-printing-press should emit server.mcp_config.env, the matching user_config prompts, server.json environmentVariables and mcp-install.md's env blocks from ONE declaration of the connector's operator-facing environment, so the three channels cannot be generated out of step. Until then check_env_schema.py compares all three and this ledger pins them.
